title: Inter-VLAN routing sub-interface administratively down
symptom: PC1 cannot reach Server1 in VLAN 30. Router-on-a-stick configuration seems broken on GigabitEthernet0/0.30.
expected_fault: The sub-interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30 is administratively disabled, which prevents routing gateway operations for VLAN 30 clients.

title: Access layer physical interface protocol down
symptom: PC2 has completely lost physical and logical connectivity to local access switch. Cable or port hardware suspected.
expected_fault: The physical cable to FastEthernet0/12 is disconnected, damaged, or the network interface card on the PC side is powered off.

title: Duplicate IP address conflict on server vlan
symptom: Critical ERP system Server1 is experiencing intermittent dropouts. Logs show ARP conflict warnings.
expected_fault: A static IP conflict exists on the network. An rogue host or secondary device has been misconfigured with the IP address of the core server: 10.30.30.50.

title: OSPF link subnet mask mismatch
symptom: OSPF neighborhood cannot form between CORE-ROUTER and BRANCH-RT. Stuck in INIT state.
expected_fault: OSPF neighbor adjacencies require subnet masks to match on broadcast links. The mask /29 on BRANCH-RT-01 conflicts with /24 on CORE-ROUTER-01.

title: PC Default Gateway IP mismatch
symptom: PC3 can ping local switch SVI but cannot browse or ping external internet servers.
expected_fault: A gateway IP mismatch on the client. The PC static default gateway configuration has a typo pointing to 10.10.10.254 instead of 10.10.10.1.

title: Missing VLAN database entry on access switch
symptom: Accounting PCs in VLAN 20 are completely isolated from the switch and router trunk link.
expected_fault: VLAN 20 was assigned to access ports but has never been added to the switch VLAN database. Ports in non-existent VLANs are kept inactive.

title: Native VLAN trunk mismatch
symptom: Cisco switches reporting native VLAN mismatch messages on syslog. Trunk link performance degraded.
expected_fault: A native VLAN mismatch exists on Gi0/1 trunk. Frames sent unencapsulated on Native VLAN 10 from Dist switch will be received in Native VLAN 99 on Access switch, creating cross-VLAN leaks.

title: Missing static route for network gateway
symptom: Headquarters cannot reach newly configured Branch subnet 192.168.50.0/24.
expected_fault: There is no static or dynamic route in the HQ-ROUTER-01 routing table for Branch subnet 192.168.50.0/24. Routing lookup fails and drops traffic.

title: Standard ACL blocking web port traffic
symptom: Clients in VLAN 10 report they cannot access HTTP/HTTPS services hosted on local core DMZ servers.
expected_fault: Access-list 101 is configured with a broad Standard ACL blocking all IP traffic from 10.10.10.0/24. This cuts off web traffic (port 80/443) which requires an Extended ACL.

title: DHCP address pool exhausted
symptom: New devices in the conference room are failing to acquire an IP address. They default to APIPA (169.254.x.x).
expected_fault: The DHCP address scope 192.168.20.0/28 is too small. With only 11 usable addresses, new conference room hosts cannot acquire IP leases.

title: NAT translation rule misconfiguration
symptom: Internal office LAN devices cannot access public internet or resolve DNS root domains.
expected_fault: The border gateway interface GigabitEthernet0/1 connected to the public ISP router is missing the 'ip nat outside' command. Address translation failed.

title: Wrong 802.1Q sub-interface encapsulation
symptom: PC4 in VLAN 40 cannot establish TCP connections. Checking VLAN binding encapsulation.
expected_fault: A VLAN tag ID mismatch. The sub-interface GigabitEthernet0/0.40 is encapsulated for VLAN 50, dropping all VLAN 40 packets.

title: Access port safety Port-Security errdisable
symptom: User moved cables and suddenly lost access. Switchport Gi0/4 LED is solid amber.
expected_fault: An unauthorized MAC address was connected to GigabitEthernet0/4. The switchport triggered its port-security violation rule and entered 'err-disabled' status.

title: Wrong subnet mask assignment on core link
symptom: Core router cannot reach distribution switch SVI. Link status up but ping failing.
expected_fault: A subnet mask mismatch. The router SVI/interface has a 30-bit mask, causing it to reject IP packets from 10.100.100.2 as outside its range.

title: VLAN mismatch on distribution port-channel
symptom: Distribution aggregation trunks dropping database synchronization frames.
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch on the active EtherChannel trunk interface Port-Channel 1. This leaks spanning-tree and administration traffic.

title: Administratively down core backbone trunk interface
symptom: Redundant link between Core and Distribution switches completely dark. No traffic throughput.
expected_fault: The GigabitEthernet0/24 interface on the core switch has been administratively disabled, disabling link aggregation failover.

title: Duplicate gateway SVI IP assignment
symptom: Corporate router gateway is flapping on ARP cache tables. MAC address conflicts occurring.
expected_fault: An access-layer switch SVI or rogue administrator has configured their interface with the gateway IP 10.1.1.1, interrupting routing.

title: ACL denying essential secure shell port 22
symptom: Network administrators cannot connect via SSH to core switches to manage VLAN databases.
expected_fault: An active access control list INGRESS-FILTER is blocking all SSH connections (TCP Port 22), preventing remote administration.

title: Gateway mismatch on finance server network
symptom: Finance file server fails to execute scheduled backups to the main backup cloud system.
expected_fault: A gateway SVI IP mismatch. The finance server is statically configured with an incorrect default gateway IP of 10.200.200.2.

title: Missing VLAN accounting database
symptom: Accounting workstation cannot ping gateway SVI. Inter-VLAN routing dropping packets on VLAN 44.
expected_fault: VLAN 44 database record is missing. FastEthernet0/12 is inactive and cannot forward packets.

title: OSPF missing static route redistribute command
symptom: Autonomous system backbone routers cannot ping corporate border static default route.
expected_fault: The border router OSPF process lacks the default-information originate statement to redistribute the ISP static default route to other routers.

title: Wrong encapsulation sub-interface binding tag
symptom: VLAN 22 clients cannot negotiate DHCP or access router sub-interface.
expected_fault: A sub-interface VLAN encapsulation mismatch. dot1Q encapsulation tag is 33 instead of matching VLAN 22.

title: DHCP relay helper address missing on interface
symptom: Branch clients in VLAN 50 cannot fetch DHCP lease. Central DHCP server is up.
expected_fault: The VLAN 50 sub-interface lacks an 'ip helper-address' routing directive. DHCP broadcast requests cannot be unicast to the central DHCP server.

title: NAT translation pool exhaustion
symptom: New branch office clients cannot browse outbound websites. Syslogs show translation pool full.
expected_fault: The outbound NAT translation pool BRANCH-POOL only contains 2 public IP addresses without 'overload' configured, causing allocation failure.

title: OSPF route advertisement area statement missing
symptom: Branch LAN routes are not advertised to CORE. Branch LAN cannot ping server.
expected_fault: The branch LAN subnet 192.168.1.0/24 is missing from OSPF advertisements, so distant routing entities do not know how to route to it.

title: Switchport native trunk VLAN leak
symptom: Cisco switch logging trunk native VLAN mismatch warnings on central management interface.
expected_fault: The trunk link has inconsistent Native VLAN bindings (VLAN 5 vs VLAN 1). Untagged frames will leak cross-VLANs and create bridging loops.

title: ACL blocking domain name service UDP port 53
symptom: Corporate PCs can ping raw server IPs but report they cannot resolve local network domain names.
expected_fault: An active Access Control List blocking UDP port 53, preventing DNS requests and cutting off symbolic name resolution.

title: Switch virtual interface administratively down
symptom: Management access lost to distribution switch DIST-SWITCH-03. SVI gateway unreachable.
expected_fault: The Switch Virtual Interface for management VLAN 10 was left shut down, completely disabling remote management.

title: Duplicate gateway SVI allocation conflict
symptom: Router SVI interface flap warning. Duplicate MAC warning on core distribution backbone.
expected_fault: A rogue host or secondary router SVI has been misconfigured with the primary gateway address: 10.10.10.1, creating an ARP conflict loop.

title: ACL blocking outgoing domain lookup
symptom: Internal office subnet unable to resolve external websites. Ping by name failing.
expected_fault: An outbound filter ACL blocks TCP/UDP DNS queries (domain / Port 53) on BORDER-ROUTER-01 GigabitEthernet0/1.
